title: LeetCode 21: Merge Two Sorted Lists
description: You are given the heads of two sorted lists `list1` and `list2`. Merge the two lists in a one sorted list and return it.
constraints:
0 <= len(list1), len(list2) <= 50
• Time: O(N + M) | Space: O(N + M)
starter_code:
def merge_two_lists(list1: list[int], list2: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    pass
solution:
def merge_two_lists(list1: list[int], list2: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    return sorted(list1 + list2)
explanation: Combines list elements and preserves sorted sequence order.
